$comment: Fifty questions an agent gets asked about a repository, each with an answer that can be checked mechanically against the repository itself - file paths, command lines, environment variable names. Ground truth was written by reading the fixture sources, not by reading the surface document, so condition B (surface) is not graded against its own output. `commands` lists accepted spellings; one match scores. `files` and `env` are scored as sets (precision and recall).
